Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Ashapura Minechem Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 earnings, highlighting record performance with consolidated revenue growing 105% in Q4 and 91% for the full year. Management discussed the impact of geopolitical unrest, rising fuel and freight costs, and input price pressures, particularly in the Guinea and India businesses. Looking forward, the company outlined expansion plans in port facilities and product developments, and noted potential positive impacts from an anticipated bauxite quota system in Guinea. Management discussed the Q3 FY26 performance, noting that consolidated revenue stood at INR 960.4 crores and EBITDA at INR 143 crores, driven by enhanced cost efficiencies and reduced demurrage charges. Operations in Guinea were impacted by prolonged monsoons affecting expected volumes, while the Indian operations faced headwinds from raw material cost volatility and climatic changes.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume for the year to be in the range of 10 to 12 million tons.
guidance.quote: this year we are expecting broadly a range of 10 to 12 million tons for next year, depending on how some of these uncertainties with respect to freight, geopolitics, and the quota system play out.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its confidence in achieving the long-term volume target of 15 million tons for FY27-FY28.
guidance.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons.

guidance.claim: Management expects a linear growth ramp-up year-on-year from last year's volume toward the 15 million ton target.
guidance.quote: So we expect like a linear ramp-up over the year-on-year and in that way. So from 3 million to 15 million with the—with the three milestones in the middle, so you can add it up how it comes by, but we are expecting a linear growth between 3 last year and 15 as a target for 27-28.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates a potential 40% to 50% moderation in EBITDA per ton due to lower bauxite pricing.
guidance.quote: I think that there can be a moderation, at least maybe there would be a 40%, 50% moderation, which -- which I expect that may come in the EBITDA, but we expect that the volumes to offset the per ton kind of the reduced EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects the next quarter (Q4) to be a record quarter for Guinea exports.
guidance.quote: Basically, I think for quarter four at least what I can comment is that we expect it to be a record quarter four for us as from a Guinea quarterly export point of view.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve its target of 15 million metric tons in FY27-28.
guidance.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.

demand_outlook.claim: Aluminium metal is trading at about $3,600 and is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton.
demand_outlook.quote: As such, the metal is doing very good, aluminium metal currently is trading at about $3,600 which is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton and that will have again some positive impact on the consumption of bauxite in coming months.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for bauxite has some disturbance due to geopolitical unrest.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand on other side, you can say that because of geopolitical unrest, the commodity cycle has some kind of a disturbance and will have some impact on the demand of the bauxite.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects bauxite prices to stabilize and gradually pick up after the Chinese New Year and Spring Festival.
demand_outlook.quote: We are waiting for the Chinese Spring Festival time, Chinese New Year time, and after that we could see that there will be some upward trend in the bauxite price.

demand_outlook.claim: Bauxite inventory levels in China are reported to be at an all-time low.
demand_outlook.quote: The inventory in China at the moment is all-time low.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for bauxite continues to be very stable.
demand_outlook.quote: However, the demand for bauxite continues to be very stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Aluminum metal prices are described as fairly strong and stable.
demand_outlook.quote: We see aluminum metal prices as fairly strong and stable and we expect this to support bauxite prices going forward.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding port facilities to increase volume capacity from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.
capex_expansion.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a significant capex of roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions over the next year.
capex_expansion.quote: We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is putting up a bauxite washing plant with a capacity of 20,000 tons per day.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also putting up the bauxite washing plant with the capacity of 20,000 tons per day which will help us to use the bauxite which is currently is not a marketable quality, which can be improved to a marketable standard and that will also enhance our ability to export more bauxite from our existing resources.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects another 20% to 25% more capex relative to what has been done to come through over the next year or year and a half in Guinea.
capex_expansion.quote: We have a -- we as -- we are expecting that maybe compared to the capex we have done, another 20%, 25% more capex may come through over the next year or year and a half or so.

capex_expansion.claim: India operations will also see some capex for expanding a couple of business capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: I think India will also see some capex which we are finalizing. We are looking at expanding a couple of our business capacities, but that may be a little bit less significant in number than even the Guinea business.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated investment for the bridge project at BOFFA would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated investment, we do not have the exact figure as on today, but it would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: The BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY'27.

capex_expansion.claim: Port expansion will lift total handling capacity from 16 million metric tons to 27 million metric tons.
capex_expansion.quote: And this will lift our total handling capacity at these ports from 16 million metric tons to 27 million metric tons, allowing us to serve both captive and third-party cargo more efficiently.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability and margins were affected by increases in fuel prices, transportation costs, higher input costs, and changes in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Given the logistics-intensive nature of our operations, increases in fuel prices and transportation costs had an impact on margins across businesses. Additionally, profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix, with a higher proportion of lower-margin products contributing to overall sales.

margins_costs.claim: Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business performance was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices.
margins_costs.quote: Within our portfolio, the performance of our Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices, which is a key raw material used in this business.

margins_costs.claim: For quarter 4, EBITDA per metric ton came in at $5.9.
margins_costs.quote: I think we have mentioned in our press release, in quarter 4 our EBITDA per metric ton has come in at $5.9.

margins_costs.claim: Improved EBITDA margin was driven by reduced demurrage charges, enhanced cost efficiencies, and new tie-ups with mining and logistics contractors.
margins_costs.quote: This was mainly driven by reduced demurrage charges, enhanced cost efficiency and like that.

margins_costs.claim: For the first nine months of FY26, consolidated revenue reached INR 3,268 crores with an EBITDA of INR 463 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Coming to nine months of ‘26, consolidated revenue stood at around INR3,268 crores, reflecting growth of almost 50% year-on-year. EBITDA came to around INR463 crores, which is 52% up compared to year-on-year, with EBITDA margin of 14.2%

margins_costs.claim: Future freight contracts at the load port are now on CQD terms, meaning no demurrage is applicable.
margins_costs.quote: Our future -- our future freight contracts at the load port, we have now working on CQD terms. So in CQD terms, there is no demurrage is applicable.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per metric ton of Guinea bauxite was USD 8.9 compared to USD 9.3 in Quarter 1.
margins_costs.quote: It was USD 8.9 per metric ton compared to USD 9.3 per metric ton in Quarter 1, supported largely by improved internal operational efficiency

margins_costs.claim: A 9-megawatt solar plant linked to the bleaching clay plant is expected to reduce power costs by a minimum of 20%.
margins_costs.quote: We foresee a minimum 20% reduction of the power cost at this plant from this initiative.

orders_capacity.claim: In Guinea, the export of bauxite reached almost 8 million tons in the last year against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last year, we have ended almost the export of 8 million tons of bauxite against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volumes are fully committed for calendar year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our production volumes are fully committed for calendar year FY'26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year, subject to shareholders' approval, which reflects both our confidence in the business and our commitment to rewarding shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Management believes debt is close to its peak or at its peak.
capital_allocation.quote: We expect at least that the debt is close to its peak or at peak really.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prolonged monsoon in Guinea impacted operations and affected overall performance during Q3.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prolonged monsoon in Guinea had impacted our operations and affecting our overall performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Indian operations faced headwinds due to volatility in raw material costs and climatic changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: the Indian operations also have seen some headwinds mainly due to volatility in the raw material cost and the climatic changes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recognized an incremental one-time labor code impact of INR 1.77 crores at the standalone level and INR 4.56 crores in the consolidated result.
risks_headwinds.quote: company has recognized an incremental impact of INR1.77 crores at standalone level and INR4.56 crores in the consolidated result as an exceptional item.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business viability for bauxite below a price of $52 would definitely be a concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: business viability below 52 is definitely a concern.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bauxite prices experienced a correction of approximately 5% over the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: As mentioned earlier, bauxite prices have seen a little bit of correction, 5% approx. over the quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company is expanding port facilities expected to be ready by the end of this year to increase volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.
management_commitments.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking at a significant capex of roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching a long-term volume of 15 million tons.
management_commitments.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons. This is for the ‘27- ‘28 as we -- as we have stated.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commercialize iron ore further within the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We are expected to commercialize further within the next two quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company is confident of achieving its target of 15 million metric tons in FY27-28.
management_commitments.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.

management_commitments.claim: The BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY'27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
